name: NeRF Training Loop
aliases: Ray Sampling Strategy for Correspondence Disparity
Training Ray Sampling Strategy for Correspondence Disparity
definition: A sampling strategy to balance training when the number of feature-matching correspondences differs significantly from the image pixel count. It fills regions without correspondences using standard photometric supervision.
summary: The NeRF Training Loop is an iterative optimization procedure that minimizes photometric error by updating neural radiance field parameters using stochastic ray sampling and adaptive integration strategies.
